recognize_zh: 淋巴球的細胞核有一條條細溝紋與皺褶，看起來像腦迴（cerebriform），染色質緻密、細胞質很少；上方較大的一顆、右下較小的一顆都有核凹陷。這種腦迴狀核就是 Sézary 細胞的特徵。
features: Atypical lymphocytes with cerebriform nuclei showing fine grooves and folds
Large Sézary cell variant (upper) with convoluted nucleus and a thin rim of pale-blue cytoplasm
Small Sézary cell variant (lower right) with an indented/notched, dense nucleus
Condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; scant agranular cytoplasm
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphocytes with cerebriform nuclei. The larger cell has a convoluted nucleus with fine grooves, condensed chromatin, and a narrow rim of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm, and a smaller cell shows an indented, hyperchromatic nucleus. The background red cells show crenation artifact. In the appropriate clinical setting of erythroderma, findings are consistent with circulating Sézary cells; flow cytometry for CD4+ T cells with loss of CD7/CD26 is recommended for quantification.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells have polylobated flower-like nuclei with deep clefts rather than fine cerebriform grooves, and HTLV-1 serology is positive.
T-PLL cells have a visible central nucleolus and basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, not grooved cerebriform nuclei.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and are few, while flow cytometry lacks a clonal CD4+CD7-/CD26- population.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Mantle cells can have notched nuclei but are B cells (CD5+, cyclin D1+) and lack the fine cerebriform grooving.
